versioning.notes: package.json hand-edited, lockfile synced in same commit. Historical anomalies: first tag 0.1.0 unprefixed; v0.11.0 gap exists.

detail.script_does: dirty-tree check, tag-exists check, files check, build, git push, annotated tag plus push tag, gh release create from changelog section. It never runs npm publish.
detail.no_registry: no local registry publish; npm publishing happens only in .github/workflows/publish.yml on the tag push
detail.partial_failure_note: script is not atomic; on mid-flight failure check what landed (pushed commits vs tag vs release) before any rerun
detail.registry_publish: the vX.Y.Z tag push triggers .github/workflows/publish.yml, which checks the tag matches package.json, runs npm ci, build and test, then npm publish --provenance --access public via npm trusted publishing (OIDC, no NPM_TOKEN)

steps: git push origin :refs/tags/vX.Y.Z && git tag -d vX.Y.Z
Revert the release commit on main, or forward-fix with a new patch version
npm cannot reuse a published version: deprecate it with npm deprecate glimmervoid@X.Y.Z and forward-fix with a new patch version
